set.body:
Scope
Test both engines and all baselines under recoverable perturbations using a protocol frozen before comparative results are inspected.

Acceptance criteria
- Representation tests cover fixation splitting/merging, detector variation, duration-preserving resampling, and pixel-to-degree conversion.
- Factorial perturbations independently vary contraction, translation, noise, time dilation, local swaps, block reordering, reversal, deletion, insertion, central bias, fixation count, duration concentration, and candidate difficulty.
- Generators include Transport-favouring, Replay-favouring, and neutral/misspecified families.
- Report held-out information bits, log loss, calibration, identification, matched-FPR power, null error, parameter recovery, runtime, and memory.
- Transport solver start/candidate-order stability and Replay likelihood/posterior stability pass declared tolerances.
- No method is tuned after inspecting the final court; any addendum is labelled.
- Machine-readable results, seeds, configuration, and a bounded verdict are reproducible byte-for-byte or within declared numeric tolerances.
- Advancement rules to the real-data gate are declared and satisfied without a universal-superiority claim.
set.title: GW-6 Run the frozen synthetic and invariance court
